title: Node.js 16 is end-of-life and no longer receives security patches
summary: Node.js 16 reached end of life on 11 September 2023. Applications still pinned to node:16 or engines.node 16 are running an unsupported runtime. A JavaScript source edit cannot patch the interpreter.
remediation: Upgrade the Node image, engines.node, .nvmrc / .node-version, and CI node-version to a currently supported release (20 LTS for this demo). Keep application source unchanged unless a compatibility check fails.
